verdict.rationale: Deel exposes a REST API and MCP server that can create contractor contracts and expose people/payroll data to agents, suggesting programmatic hiring is plausible, but the evidence never shows an explicit 'create employee' (vs contractor) endpoint or any tax-setup/compensation-configuration API call, so full end-to-end onboarding is not demonstrated. missing for 10: explicit employee-creation endpoint, compensation-setup API call, tax-setup API call/tool, and an end-to-end example chaining these steps.
